messages:
DeployBot: Rollout started for release v3.16.0 -> prod (gradual traffic 10% -> 100%). Canary: eu-west-1, us-west-2.
Maria S.: seeing p95 spike on /v1/embeddings, +120ms vs baseline since 20m ago. Not huge but climbing.
Ryan: any increase in 5xx or just latency?
Maria S.: small uptick in 5xx (0.8% -> 2.4%) mostly from a subset of hosts.
DeployBot: Alert: error_rate(/v1/embeddings) > 2% for 3m. Auto-rollback eligible per policy. Suggested action: AUTO-ROLLBACK (threshold breach).
Maria S.: HOLD auto-rollback. This release intentionally changes tokenization/kv behavior; customers were pre-notified in notes. We need a manual decision path — only rollback if user-facing failures escalate.
Sophia: agree with manual hold. Let's define clear criteria for manual rollback: (A) sustained error rate >5% for 5m, or (B) >10% of requests failing for any single tenant, or (C) SLA p95 > 500ms for 10m. If none of those, keep canary and triage.
Tomas (oncall): I'll take exec if criteria hit. Manual revert plan: run `redwoodctl rollout revert --release v3.15.2 --selector=prod` and pin traffic to stable pool. I'll also open an incident channel and notify PG.
DeployBot: Acknowledged. Auto-rollback suppressed by human-hold flag set by Maria S. Monitoring hook adjusted to escalate to #eng-oncall after criteria.
Lex: I'll prepare a short customer communication template and a rollback blurb for the release notes page. If we revert, publish statement: "We reverted to v3.15.2 due to observed embedding regressions; working on hotfix."
Maria S.: Action items: Tomas standby for revert, Lex on comms, Ryan dig into embed model logs and host flags, Sophia continue metric watch. If manual revert occurs, use runbook link on the top of the thread and tag legal if production customers impacted.
DeployBot: Manual hold registered by Maria S. at 5380000010. No auto action will be taken while hold is present.
Ryan: quick root cause: one subset of hosts had quantization flag `--kv-preserve=false` due to an older bootstrap image; KV cache mismatch causing transient decode failures. Pushing a hotpatch to canary hosts now (rolling restart).
Maria S.: Good catch. If hotpatch fixes errors in canary within 10m, we keep roll forward. If not, Tomas executes revert at T+15m.
Tomas (oncall): Ready. I'll execute revert and send notice to #customers if we hit manual criteria. Pin target: v3.15.2; notify sales and success.
DeployBot: Hotpatch rollout to canary completed. Telemetry: p95 returning to baseline, error rate back to 0.6% in canary slice. Suppressed auto-rollback remains until manual clear.
Sophia: Monitoring green for 6m. No single-tenant spike.
Maria S.: Proceed to 50% in 10m, continue watching. If anything regresses, abort to manual revert.
Lex: Drafted comms and rollback paragraph. Will be ready to publish if Tomas confirms revert.
Ryan: digging through logs, confirming no downstream side effects.
Maria S.: Thanks team. Closing human hold at 5380000115 and continuing rollout per rollback policy. Will leave a post-deploy note in the release doc.
DeployBot: Human hold cleared by Maria S. at 5380000115. Rollout scheduled to reach 100% in 10m unless new alerts.
Maria S.: :thumbsup: Closing thread unless anyone sees new red flags.
